lead: From 2 weeks: a cosmetic renovation refreshes surfaces without replacing utilities — painting walls and ceilings, wallpaper, new flooring, doors, skirting, light fittings and sockets. Our own salaried team does it — for an apartment before renting out or selling, or simply to refresh the interior.
cards: new laminate, vinyl or engineered boards
about: Cosmetic renovation is the smallest type of renovation: we do not touch what is hidden in walls and floors, we refresh the visible surfaces. It suits apartments where electrics and plumbing are in good order and the place needs refreshing — after tenants, before a sale or before moving in.
If the survey shows the wiring or pipes are old or the walls are badly out of true, we say so honestly: then cosmetics would be temporary, and it is better to plan a major renovation.

We price cosmetic renovation per estimate: it depends on the area, the condition of walls and ceilings, the chosen materials and whether you live in the apartment during the works. There is no separate rate per m² — the scope varies too much between apartments.
For a full turnkey renovation the benchmark is from $550/m² (works and rough materials). The survey is paid; a phone consultation is free.

faq: Painting walls and ceilings, wallpaper, new flooring, doors and skirting, sockets, switches and light fittings, minor plumbing. Replacing wiring, pipes and screed is already a major renovation.
How much does cosmetic renovation cost in Kyiv?
Per estimate after a site survey: it depends on area, condition of surfaces and materials. The survey is paid; the cost is individual.
Can you renovate while we live in the apartment?
Yes, in parts — room by room. We cover furniture and floors with film and clean the work zone every day.
How long does cosmetic renovation take?
It depends on the scope and is fixed in the contract — from 2 weeks.
12 months on completed works. Our own salaried team works, no subcontractors from classified ads.
